title: Motion 4406: Impôt minimal mondial sur la fortune des milliardaires
summary: Motion inviting the government to press at OECD and EU level for a global annual minimum tax on the wealth of billionaires (and holders above USD 100m), after the Brazilian G20 presidency's proposal.
status: Refusé(e): rejected by 40 votes to 20 on 13 November 2024.
